about_the_game:
Echoes of Tomorrow is an action RPG that blends intense, skill-based combat with survival and choice-driven mechanics. Aiming to bring greater depth to the modern post-apocalyptic adventures by grounding it in deep character conflict, moral ambiguity, and a unique world-restoration system designed to reward curiosity and challenge player assumptions around morality.

Venture into a detailed, unforgiving world where constant environmental exposure and scarce resources demand strategic management. Survival means more than just fighting; you must use crafted items to stave off sickness and rely on scattered campfires for sanctuary. Engage in combat against a mix of organic and cybernetic monsters, where some foes are reluctant and can be spared, forcing you to think before you strike.

Your journey is guided by Key2, an ancient robotic relic from the world before the collapse. Utilise Key2 to scan, reveal lore and restore lost ruins and technology using salvaged Crystals. This temporary restoration is key to solving puzzles, accessing pathways, and deploying powerful attacks from Key2—but these special actions deplete its energy, forcing you to choose when and where to use them.

As an amnesiac, banished cleric falsely accused of the Divine Disease, you are thrust into a society split between those who enjoy sanctuary and those who face monstrous ruin. As your memory returns, will you shatter the theocracy's illusion that maintains a fragile order, or protect the lives built upon a powerful lie?

Your companion Key2's loyalty to the lost, advanced society of the past leads it to judge current inhabitants as inferior, setting up constant moral debates that shape your actions and the world's outcome.
